title: Shader Tools workspace settings
description: Project settings sent to shader-language-server. Project values override user settings; objects merge and arrays replace.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL or relative schema path for JSON editor support.

symbols.description: Enable language features backed by shader symbols.

symbolDiagnostics.description: Show internal symbol analysis diagnostics. Usually useful only when debugging the language server.

validateConfig.description: Ask the language server to validate referenced paths and compiler combinations.

automaticVariantDiscovery.description: Reuse a dependent main-file context when an include file is analyzed.

experimentalMacroExpansion.description: Include experimental macro expansion in symbol analysis.

severity.description: Lowest compiler diagnostic severity shown by the editor.

includes.description: Include directories. Relative paths use the directory containing this settings file.

defines.description: Global preprocessor symbols. Values must be strings, including numeric-looking values.

pathRemapping.description: Maps virtual include prefixes to directories. Target values are resolved relative to this settings file.

stageDefine.description: Preprocessor symbols added for a specific shader stage.

configOverride.description: Optional shader-language-server override JSON file, resolved relative to this settings file.

targetClient.description: GLSL client environment used for compilation.

spirvVersion.description: SPIR-V version targeted by GLSL compilation.

preamble.description: Optional file prepended to every GLSL shader, resolved relative to this settings file.

enable16bitTypes.description: Enable native 16-bit scalar types. Requires a compatible shader model and HLSL version.

spirv.description: Allow SPIR-V syntax and compilation behavior for HLSL.
